readerCopy.headline: Take the invitation seriously.
readerCopy.body:
Someone may invite you into a room you would not have entered on your own, recommend you, or give you a chance to try something before you feel completely ready. The opening can look ordinary at first. A conversation becomes an introduction. A casual invitation puts you in front of someone useful. A small yes changes how people see you.

Jupiter sextile your Ascendant works best when you participate. You do not need a total reinvention. Show up, introduce yourself, answer the message, and let people meet the version of you that exists now. The opportunity can grow later. Your job is to give it enough of a response to find out what it actually is.
doNotAssume: Do not assume the reader wants more social contact, a new identity, or a permanent commitment.
